market_summary: Two-tier market definitive. Growth/AI severely broken (QQQ below all key MAs, RS deteriorating) while value/healthcare/steel/defense hit new highs. 'Beat-and-raise' now sold aggressively — SANM -17% is new regime. David Ryan actively shorting: 2-4 day rallies into declining 50/21-day MAs = short entries. NBIS short +20-25% in 3 days. 'Once a stock drops 50%, they're not coming back.' Fed Warsh meeting. Iran de-escalation FAILED to lift market. Gessel screening shorts. Morris: 'Cash is a position.'

MXL.story: MaxLinear: EPS +1,650% but stock collapsed in 3 days. Ryan: "A stock down 50% rarely recovers quickly — don't bottom-fish." Poster child for broken growth.

WDC.story: Western Digital: "The poster child" — climactic vertical run, complete collapse. Failed rallies into declining MAs. Classic short setup.

NBIS.technical_action: Ryan shorted at 50-day MA rejection; gained 20-25% in 3 days
NBIS.story: Nebius: dropped $300→$260, rallied 4 days right into declining 50-day. Textbook short entry. "The setup was right there."

CRDO.story: Credo Technology: peaked near $300, pulled back, MA rejection, significant downside in 3 days.

MU.technical_action: Climactic run, MA breakdown, failed relief rallies
MU.story: Micron: identical pattern to WDC/MXL — huge run, collapse, rejection at declining MAs.

DELL.technical_action: Ryan exited weeks ago as it "wedged up" with unhealthy volatility, broke 50-day
DELL.story: Dell: one of the last hardware plays to crack. Tight/volatile action was distribution, not consolidation.

INTC.story: Intel: "When great earnings are completely ignored, the market direction is fundamentally broken." The market looks 6 months out.

SANM.technical_action: -17% on beat-and-raise quarter (beat EPS, beat revenue, raised FY26 guidance above consensus)
SANM.story: Sanmina: THE poster child for the new sell regime. Traditional beat-and-raise = automatic rally is DEAD. Market is punishing good news.

APLD.technical_action: +2% on surprise profit + 406% revenue gain (down 50% from highs)
APLD.story: Applied Digital: neo-cloud play. Massive fundamental beat rewarded with a shrug. "The market doesn't care about good news right now."

AMD.technical_action: Signed 500MW AI deal with Core Scientific — stock cracked anyway
AMD.story: AMD: AI infrastructure deal that would have sparked a rally in any other market. Now ignored as sector gravity overwhelms.

ANET.technical_action: Poised for earnings, plunged below 50-day right before
ANET.story: Arista Networks: looked good going into earnings, but market pressure overwhelmed the setup.

WELL.story: Welltower: REIT leader. Steady performer in two-tier market.

NUE.technical_action: Trading in solid uptrend, beat views with +23% revenue
NUE.story: Nucor: steel leader. Value rotation beneficiary.

KO.technical_action: Beat views (+7% revenue), raised guidance, broke out of consolidation

DINO.technical_action: Solid beat, +53% revenue, dividend +5%, spinoff lubricants/specialties
DINO.story: HF Sinclair: refiner strength. Unlocking value through corporate action.

BA.story: Boeing: wider loss on Air Force One costs, but commercial side beat, lifting GE, RTX.

GE.technical_action: Boosted by BA commercial aerospace strength

JNJ.technical_action: Holding short consolidation; $5.5B talc settlement agreed
JNJ.story: Johnson & Johnson: settled remaining talc ovarian cancer lawsuits. Defensive/pharma holding.
